fewShots.question: What is the average BER rating for dwellings in Cork?
fewShots.query: SELECT g.CountyName, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Total_Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_geography] g ON f.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey WHERE g.CountyName = 'Cork' GROUP BY g.CountyName;

fewShots.question: Which county has the worst average energy performance?
fewShots.query: SELECT g.CountyName, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Total_Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_geography] g ON f.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey GROUP BY g.CountyName ORDER BY Avg_BerRating DESC;

fewShots.question: Which county has the best average energy performance?
fewShots.query: SELECT g.CountyName, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Total_Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_geography] g ON f.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey GROUP BY g.CountyName ORDER BY Avg_BerRating ASC;

fewShots.question: How many dwellings built between 1940 and 1960 have a BER rating below 150?
fewShots.query: SELECT c.Construction_Era, COUNT(*) AS Dwelling_Count FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_construction_era] c ON f.AgeKey = c.AgeKey WHERE c.Year_of_Construction BETWEEN 1940 AND 1960 AND f.BerRating < 150 GROUP BY c.Construction_Era ORDER BY c.Construction_Era;

fewShots.question: What proportion of dwellings in the most deprived areas have a BER rating above 300?
fewShots.query: SELECT d.ED_Name, d.NUTS4 AS County, COUNT(*) AS Total_Dwellings, SUM(CASE WHEN f.BerRating > 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS High_BER_Count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.BerRating > 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS High_BER_Pct FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_small_area_mapping] sam ON f.SA_Code = sam.SA_PUB2016 LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_deprivation_index] d ON sam.ED_ENGLISH = d.ED_Name WHERE d.share >= 0.5 GROUP BY d.ED_Name, d.NUTS4 ORDER BY High_BER_Pct DESC;

fewShots.question: Show me the average CO2 emissions per county ranked from worst to best.
fewShots.query: SELECT g.CountyName, ROUND(AVG(f.CO2Rating), 2) AS Avg_CO2_kg_m2_yr, COUNT(*) AS Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_geography] g ON f.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey GROUP BY g.CountyName ORDER BY Avg_CO2_kg_m2_yr DESC;

fewShots.question: How has the average BER rating changed year-over-year across all of Ireland?
fewShots.query: SELECT YEAR(f.DateOfAssessment) AS Assessment_Year, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, ROUND(MIN(f.BerRating), 2) AS Min_BerRating, ROUND(MAX(f.BerRating), 2) AS Max_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Assessments_That_Year FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f WHERE f.DateOfAssessment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY YEAR(f.DateOfAssessment) ORDER BY Assessment_Year ASC;

fewShots.question: Which dwelling types have the best and worst average energy intensity per square metre?
fewShots.query: SELECT f.DwellingTypeDescr, ROUND(AVG(f.Energy_Intensity_Per_SqM), 2) AS Avg_Energy_Intensity, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Count FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f WHERE f.Energy_Intensity_Per_SqM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.DwellingTypeDescr ORDER BY Avg_Energy_Intensity ASC;

fewShots.question: What is the average BER rating improvement for dwellings that received an SEAI upgrade?
fewShots.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Upgraded, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating_Before, ROUND(AVG(CAST(f.Updated_Energy_Rating AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 2) AS Avg_BerRating_After, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating - CAST(f.Updated_Energy_Rating AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 2) AS Avg_Improvement FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f WHERE f.HESSchemeUpgrade = 1 AND f.Updated_Energy_Rating IS NOT NULL;

fewShots.question: Is there a relationship between deprivation level and average BER rating at electoral division level?
fewShots.query: SELECT d.ED_Name, d.NUTS4 AS County, ROUND(d.share, 3) AS Deprivation_Share, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, ROUND(MIN(f.BerRating), 2) AS Min_BerRating, ROUND(MAX(f.BerRating), 2) AS Max_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Total_Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_small_area_mapping] sam ON f.SA_Code = sam.SA_PUB2016 LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_deprivation_index] d ON sam.ED_ENGLISH = d.ED_Name WHERE d.share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ED_Name, d.NUTS4, d.share HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY d.share DESC;

fewShots.question: What are the top 10 small areas in Dublin with the highest average CO2 emissions?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 10 sam.SA_PUB2016 AS Small_Area_Code, sam.ED_ENGLISH AS Electoral_Division, sam.COUNTY_ENGLISH AS County, ROUND(AVG(f.CO2Rating), 2) AS Avg_CO2_kg_m2_yr, COUNT(*) AS Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_small_area_mapping] sam ON f.SA_Code = sam.SA_PUB2016 WHERE sam.COUNTY_ENGLISH LIKE '%Dublin%' AND f.CO2Rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sam.SA_PUB2016, sam.ED_ENGLISH, sam.COUNTY_ENGLISH HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY Avg_CO2_kg_m2_yr DESC;

fewShots.question: What is the breakdown of main space heating fuel types across all Irish dwellings?
fewShots.query: SELECT f.MainSpaceHeatingFuel, COUNT(*) AS Dwelling_Count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 1) AS Pct_of_Total, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f WHERE f.MainSpaceHeatingFuel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.MainSpaceHeatingFuel ORDER BY Dwelling_Count DESC;

fewShots.question: Compare pre-1919 and post-2000 dwellings in terms of wall U-values and average BER rating.
fewShots.query: SELECT CASE WHEN c.Year_of_Construction < 1919 THEN 'Pre-1919' WHEN c.Year_of_Construction > 2000 THEN 'Post-2000' END AS Era_Group, ROUND(AVG(f.UValueWall), 3) AS Avg_UValue_Wall, ROUND(AVG(f.UValueRoof), 3) AS Avg_UValue_Roof, ROUND(AVG(f.UValueWindow), 3) AS Avg_UValue_Window, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_construction_era] c ON f.AgeKey = c.AgeKey WHERE c.Year_of_Construction < 1919 OR c.Year_of_Construction > 2000 GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.Year_of_Construction < 1919 THEN 'Pre-1919' WHEN c.Year_of_Construction > 2000 THEN 'Post-2000' END ORDER BY Era_Group;

fewShots.question: How does average BER rating compare between urban and rural dwellings?
fewShots.query: SELECT CASE WHEN sam.SA_URBAN_AREA_FLAG = 1 THEN 'Urban' ELSE 'Rural' END AS Area_Type, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, ROUND(AVG(f.CO2Rating), 2) AS Avg_CO2_kg_m2_yr, COUNT(*) AS Total_Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_small_area_mapping] sam ON f.SA_Code = sam.SA_PUB2016 WHERE sam.SA_URBAN_AREA_FLAG IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN sam.SA_URBAN_AREA_FLAG = 1 THEN 'Urban' ELSE 'Rural' END ORDER BY Avg_BerRating ASC;

fewShots.question: Which counties have the highest proportion of dwellings with solar hot water heating?
fewShots.query: SELECT g.CountyName, COUNT(*) AS Total_Assessments, SUM(CASE WHEN f.SolarHotWaterHeating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Solar_HW_Count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.SolarHotWaterHeating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS Solar_HW_Pct, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_geography] g ON f.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey GROUP BY g.CountyName ORDER BY Solar_HW_Pct DESC;

fewShots.question: Show the average BER rating broken down by both county and construction era.
fewShots.query: SELECT g.CountyName, c.Construction_Era, ROUND(AVG(f.BerRating), 2) AS Avg_BerRating, ROUND(MIN(f.BerRating), 2) AS Min_BerRating, ROUND(MAX(f.BerRating), 2) AS Max_BerRating, COUNT(*) AS Assessments FROM [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[fact_sustainability_assessments] f LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_geography] g ON f.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey LEFT JOIN [lh_sustainability_gold].[dbo].[dim_construction_era] c ON f.AgeKey = c.AgeKey GROUP BY g.CountyName, c.Construction_Era ORDER BY g.CountyName, c.Construction_Era;
